summary: xAI launched a built-in plugin marketplace for Grok Build that bundles skills, slash commands, agents, hooks, MCP servers and LSPs from partners like MongoDB, Vercel, Sentry, Chrome DevTools and Cloudflare, installable via the CLI.

practices.reason: A new plugin catalog and CLI install mechanism adds an optional integration surface for teams building on Grok Build, but creates no mandatory migration work.
practices.quote: The marketplace is built into Grok Build, so you can browse, install, and update plugins without leaving your terminal.
